notes.subject: יגור
notes.rationale: 'sojourn/dwell among us' vs 'can dwell with' — same root גור as 'dwell as stranger'; Tok Pisin uses 'stap wantaim'.

notes.subject: ol man two-pela pasin
notes.rationale: חנפים literally 'soiled/defiled with sin' — godless, not merely hypocrites (KJV).

notes.subject: ol i tok
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no speech frame; supplied to mark the quoted questions.

notes.subject: Husat man inap…
notes.rationale: Rhetorical unanswered question — who can dwell with the devouring fire? The answer is withheld until v15.

notes.subject: מי יגור לנו… מי יגור לנו
notes.rationale: Exact repetition of the question, Hebrew parallelism flattened slightly by identical Tok Pisin.

translation: Ol man nogut long Tsaion i scare olgeta; guria i holim ol man two-pela pasin. Ol i tok: Husat man inap stap wantaim mipela long ⟨em⟩ paia i kaikai olgeta? Husat man inap stap wantaim mipela long ol paia i nap long olgeta taim?
